lede: Everest Garage is a Ford Everest specialist at Synergy@KB, 25 Kaki Bukit Road 4. Its website says it is dedicated to Ford Everest maintenance and has handled more than 6,000 Everests.
services: Regular maintenance, yearly or every 10,000 km
Heavy maintenance: filters, fluids, belts and brakes
good_for: Owners who want original parts or established brands, per its website
